subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 stay open as the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with narrower canonical issues for session ownership, subagent completion delivery, fallback-lane ownership, and detached child cleanup?
rationale: The remaining failures are valid but cross product boundaries: a narrow repair job cannot choose the permanent contract for requester-session ownership, completion isolation, fallback lanes, and cancellation/cleanup semantics.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep #43367 open, use the focused linked issues and PRs for implementation, and close this only after live multi-agent proof covers all central symptoms.

options.title: Split Into Canonical Trackers
options.body: Close or supersede the umbrella only after creating or designating narrower canonical issues for each remaining root cause and linking the evidence there.

options.title: Declare Out Of Scope
options.body: Reject the broader orchestration expectations and close the linked cluster with a supported alternative, accepting that current multi-agent orchestration remains limited.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep #43367 open, use the focused linked issues and PRs for implementation, and close this only after live multi-agent proof covers all central symptoms.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product and architecture direction, and the VISION.md guardrails are the key constraint on how broad an orchestration fix should be.
